scope:
Execute production manual inventory/table models and independently read their XLSX.

This checks the shared typed row source used for DWG/XLSX, not an AutoCAD Table
entity, native command interaction, transaction, or live UI. Exit 2 is blocked.

cases.name: initial inventory preserves every selected object without claiming quantities
evaluated inventory retains accepted unknown unsupported and generated conflict reasons
manual mark punctuation and source layer survive presentation
repeated selected handle remains visible while physical preview counts once
block label and piece-only dimensions do not invent profile length
mixed generated and manual quantities include three physical pieces without excluded objects
unaccounted appendix is structured and repeat rendering cannot append it twice
cladding export contains the same typed quantities and unaccounted appendix
unknown-only refusal has no invented subtotal or accepted zero
known empty valid scope remains distinct from unknown-only refusal
frame appendix preserves exact metres and keeps unknown symbols out of length totals

xlsx_checks: manual_cladding: all typed row values survive export
manual_cladding: text never becomes spreadsheet formula
manual_frame: all typed row values survive export
manual_frame: text never becomes spreadsheet formula
mixed physical total excludes unaccounted objects
physical rail metres and exact member length remain numbers
piece-only bracket has no invented metres
unknown rail object retains reason in export
unknown-only model has inventory but no zero subtotal
